title.vi: CTE: truy vấn viết theo từng bước
title.en: CTEs: writing queries step by step

summary.vi: WITH ... AS, nhiều CTE, đệ quy cơ bản
summary.en: WITH ... AS, multiple CTEs, basic recursion

files.name: query.sql
files.code:
WITH order_totals AS (
  SELECT oi.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS total
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
  GROUP BY oi.order_id
)
SELECT order_id, total
FROM order_totals
WHERE total > 5000000
ORDER BY total DESC;

prompt.vi: Dùng CTE order_totals (tổng tiền mỗi đơn) rồi chọn các đơn có tổng lớn hơn 5000000. Trả về order_id và total.
prompt.en: Use a CTE order_totals (the total of each order) then select the orders whose total is above 5000000. Return order_id and total.

hint.vi: WITH order_totals AS (...) SELECT order_id, total FROM order_totals WHERE total > 5000000
hint.en: WITH order_totals AS (...) SELECT order_id, total FROM order_totals WHERE total > 5000000

solution.name: query.sql
solution.code:
WITH order_totals AS (
  SELECT oi.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * p.price) AS total
  FROM order_items oi
  JOIN products p ON p.id = oi.product_id
  GROUP BY oi.order_id
)
SELECT c.name, SUM(t.total) AS spent
FROM customers c
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.id
JOIN order_totals t ON t.order_id = o.id
GROUP BY c.name
ORDER BY spent DESC
LIMIT 1;
